body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Samsung anticipates unveiling ''Yepp K3'' its new mp3 player with flash-memory in CES 2007 Las Vegas, USA early January.

It will feature 1.8-inch full color OLED touch screen, FM radio tuner, image viewer and more. A company official said that they were still deciding specification and price for the K3, but it would be soon available at the show.
